pageProps.title: Blanco Court Prawn Mee
pageProps.review: Check out this review of Blanco Court Prawn Mee, a famous Singaporean spot known for its rich prawn broth noodles, along with useful visiting tips like cash payments and ordering juice.
pageProps.content: ## Review I went early and fortunately was able to eat right away without waiting. The interior might look a bit unhygienic and hot, which could be off-putting, but since it's a famous spot, I went in without hesitation. The broth might seem light at first, but it's rich with a deep prawn flavor. I really enjoyed it. You have to pay in cash, and I recommend ordering a juice from the separate stall next to the ordering counter. ## Pictures
